product_one_liner.value: Vectary helps designers and teams develop concepts with AI and create and share interactive 3D presentations and augmented-reality experiences online.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes AI concept development, interactive 3D presentations, AR, sharing, and collaboration; the company profile identifies designers as users: https://www.vectary.com/ and https://linkedin.com/company/9411207.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists and lists plans, including Pro AI: http://vectary.com/pricing.
